website_summary.name: Data Science Learning Hub
website_summary.description: The website presents a clean and organized interface for users to explore and engage with various data science courses, featuring a dark olive green theme with honeydew accents.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a header with a logo and navigation options such as "Courses," "Grades," and a logout button. Below the header, there's a section titled "Available Courses," which displays course cards for "Python Basics," "Data Analysis with Python," and "Machine Learning Basics." Each card includes a title, brief description, progress bar, and a "Start Learning" button. The background uses a honeydew color, while the components are styled in dark olive green. Filters for "All," "Text," and "Video" content types are available above the course listings. A "Student View" toggle is also present.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to browse through available courses, filter them by content type, view course details, track progress via progress bars, and initiate learning sessions using the "Start Learning" buttons. It also supports user authentication, enabling access to personalized features like grades and logout functionality.
